author: Temminck, 1836
status: 겨울철새 10만 마리 이상 · 텃새 10만 마리 이상 · 나그네새 수만 마리
habitat: 산림, 경작지, 습지 주변의 관목과 덤불
summary: 숲과 경작지, 습지 주변의 관목과 덤불에 사는 텃새로, 전국에서 볼 수 있다. 번식기에는 세력권을 지키느라 흩어져 지내다가, 번식이 끝나면 수십 마리까지 무리를 지어 다닌다. 나무 꼭대기나 전깃줄처럼 드러난 곳에 앉아 울기 때문에 소리 나는 곳을 찾으면 쉽게 볼 수 있다. 국외에서는 연해주, 중국, 일본에 분포한다.

points.en: crown feathers sometimes raised in a crest
deep yellow chin and band from above the eye to the nape (male)

sexes.male: 턱밑과 눈 위에서 뒷머리까지 짙은 노란색이고 눈선과 윗가슴은 검어, 얼굴이 노랑과 검정으로 얼룩덜룩해 보인다.
sexes.female: 윗가슴과 눈선에 검은색이 없고 노란 부분도 흐릿하다.

art.subject: Yellow-throated Bunting (Emberiza elegans), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen in Korean scrub and woodland edges in spring: black crown and an erectile black crest; bright yellow supercilium running from above the eye back to the hindcrown; black lores and ear-coverts forming a black face mask; bright yellow chin and throat; a black triangular patch on the upper breast; greyish nape; mantle and scapulars chestnut-brown streaked black; belly white; flanks streaked chestnut; wings brown with two whitish wing bars; tail dark brown with white outer feathers. Short, stout conical bill dark grey; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: singing from the top of a tree with its crown feathers raised
art.scene: Korean spring: shrubs and thickets at the edge of woodland and farmland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched with crest raised: black crest and face mask, bright yellow supercilium to the hindcrown and yellow throat, black upper-breast patch, chestnut-streaked brown back, white belly, short stout bill
adult female, side view perched: brown crest and ear-coverts instead of black, pale buff-yellow supercilium and throat, no black breast patch, streaked brown upperparts, whitish underparts
adult in flight seen from above: streaked brown back, dark tail with white outer feathers, head, body and tail in a straight line
art.build: Small bunting, 16cm, a little longer than a sparrow with a longer tail; perches upright on treetops and wires to sing. A distinct pointed crest is raised when excited and lies flatter otherwise, still giving a peaked head. Bill short, stout and conical, much shorter than the head. Legs short, pinkish. At rest the wingtips reach just past the base of the tail. Tail medium-long, notched, dark with white outer feathers that flash in flight.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow breast or belly — that is Yellow-breasted Bunting; here the yellow is only on the throat and supercilium.
Do not paint the crest or ear-coverts yellow; on the male the crest and face mask are black.
Do not omit the male's black upper-breast patch.
Do not paint any black on the female's face or breast.
